mapper.select: select count(1) from trace_query_log where date(query_time) = curdate()
select count(1) from trace_feedback where del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from trace_feedback where del_flag = '0' and is_suspicious = '1'
select ifnull(avg(rating), 0) from trace_feedback where del_flag = '0' and rating is not null
select count(1) from trace_batch where del_flag = '0'
select count(distinct batch_id) from trace_process_record where del_flag = '0'
select count(distinct batch_id) from trace_quality_report where del_flag = '0'
select count(distinct batch_id) from trace_bottling_info where del_flag = '0'
select count(distinct bi.batch_id) from trace_warehouse_bill_detail d left join trace_bottling_info bi on bi.bottling_id = d.bottling_id where d.del_flag = '0'

select date_format(query_time, '%m-%d') as dayLabel, count(1) as queryCount from trace_query_log where query_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(query_time, '%m-%d') order by dayLabel asc
select ifnull(product_name, '未命名产品') as name, count(1) as value from trace_query_log where query_status = '1' group by product_name order by value desc limit 8
select concat(rating, '星') as name, count(1) as value from trace_feedback where del_flag = '0' and rating is not null group by rating order by rating asc

select trace_code as traceCode, enterprise_name as enterpriseName, product_name as productName, content, create_time as createTime, status from ( select f.trace_code, e.enterprise_name, p.product_name, f.content, f.create_time, f.status from trace_feedback f left join trace_bottling_info bi on bi.bottling_id = f.bottling_id left join trace_batch b on b.batch_id = bi.batch_id left join trace_product p on p.product_id = b.product_id left join trace_vineyard_plot vp on vp.plot_id = b.plot_id left join trace_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = vp.enterprise_id where f.del_flag = '0' and f.is_suspicious = '1' order by f.create_time desc limit 10 ) t
